findings.reader: A well-executed dated news article: it answers the rollout question first, explains the speech-versus-background-processing mechanism accurately, keeps uncertainty about per-account availability alive, and converts the insight into a proportionate no-cost test. Explain-back and a novel booking transfer scenario both succeed on the article's mechanism alone. No defect families present.
findings.facts: Complete factual verification against the three Google primary captures: all eleven claims are supported, including the pivotal turnComplete-is-not-idle documentation claim (thinking-doc L108) and the exact Workspace subscription boundaries (blog L341). Attribution and provider limits are preserved throughout, dates are checkable, and uncertainty about per-account availability is correctly retained.
